newsitem.title: GERMANY: Oil World details Argentine oilseeds estimates.
newsitem.headline: Oil World details Argentine oilseeds estimates.

text.p: Dryness in Argentina's oilseed growing regions means production will be below earlier forecasts but still above last year, the independent Oil World newsletter said.
The publication put total oilseed production in 1996/97 at 20.04 million tonnes, up from 19.48 million in 95/96.
Soybean production was estimated at 13.40 million tonnes after 12.53 million last season. But if dry weather continued, the crop may fall to 13.0 million, or below, Oil World said.
Sunseed was put at 5.30 million tonnes compared with 5.56 million in the 95/96 season
Groundnuts were forecast at 500,000 tonnes compared with last year's 462,000.
Argentina also grows cottonseed, rapeseed, safflowerseed and linseed.
Oil World said some 50-60 percent of the oilseeds area was affected by dry weather in February and early March and more rain was needed over the next few weeks to bring relief.
Argentine oils/fats exports in 96/97 were forecast up 381,000 tonnes at 3.65 million while oilmeal exports were put at 11.00 million, up 307,000.
